text:
Ethan: Heads-up 10 - GreenBank wants a PoC. Requirement: all customer data (requests + embeddings) must remain in CA (ca-central1) or EU (eu-west-1) depending on tenant, explicitly no US egress. They also asked if we support HSM-backed BYOK and what the pricing bump is. Need a one-pager for presales.

Priya: Got it. Can you share timeline? Is this just hosted or are they asking for Dedicated right away?

Ethan: They're open but legal prefers Dedicated to get hard guarantees. Pilot target next month.

Noah: Quick infra breakdown: Dedicated -> we can do strict geofencing per-tenant. We have compute pools in AWS eu-west-1 and GCP ca-central1. Network path will be local provided we bind tenant routing and disable failover. If a zone is full we won't failover automatically if policy is "deny_on_capacity".

Anya: Security note: we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) with KMS integrations for AWS KMS and Cloud HSM on GCP. HSM-backed keys require additional paperwork and an integration window (~7-10 business days). We also need to confirm subprocessor attestations for our peering partner (NetGate / FastTransit) in CA.

Priya: Can you summarize the costs so I can put in the quote? I'm thinking: Dedicated multi-region reservation + BYOK integration + HSM add-on.

Noah: Pricing roughs: Dedicated baseline +25% for multi-region reserve (because of capacity set aside). BYOK integration is $5k one-time + $1k/month KMS ops. HSM add-on +$8k one-time + $2k/month for HSM support/rotations. These are placeholders; finance will confirm.

Ethan: Legal will ask about key destruction on contract termination and proof of deletion. Anya, what can we provide?

Anya: We can provide key lifecycle docs: policy for crypto key rotation, scheduled destruction, and a signed attestation of key destruction on termination. For Hosted we can only rotate and mark keys deleted; for Dedicated with customer-managed HSM we can coordinate key destruction and provide logs. We'll include a sample attestation template.

Priya: Good. Also need to know about caching: are embeddings or KV shards ever replicated outside tenant region? GreenBank specifically disallows cross-border replication.

Noah: On Dedicated with geofenced tenant, embedding caches and KV shards are region-local by default and not replicated. We do have optional cross-region read-replicas for HA that are opt-in and requires explicit customer consent. Hosted tier may replicate to a hot-failover region.

Ethan: Can we get an exported subprocessor list + dates and SOC/ISO certs for the customer questionnaire?

Anya: I'll attach SOC2 Type II report reference and ISO27001 cert link, and export the subproc list (subproc_list_2026-03-24.csv). For NetGate / FastTransit CA attestation I will request signed confirmation; ETA 48-72h.

DeployBot: PRESALES-4890 created for GreenBank PoC (assignee: Priya).

Priya: Plan: I'll draft two proposal paths for GreenBank:
- Path 1: Dedicated geofence (recommended): hard residency, BYOK/HSM supported, +multi-region pricing.
- Path 2: Hosted geo-preference: faster onboarding, best-effort residency, potential fallback, lower cost.

Ethan: Timeline: draft to customer by Tue COB. Priya, loop in Legal for the attestation language and Finance for firm numbers.

Noah: I'll prepare a short runbook paragraph describing routing behavior, fallback_policy examples (deny_on_capacity vs failover_to_region), and KV locality.

Anya: Also adding KMS integration checklist (required IAM roles, audit log endpoints, rotation windows).

Priya: Thanks all. I'll upload the quote and attach certs once I have numbers. Ping me in thread if any of the attestation items are delayed. :thumbsup:

Ethan: Awesome. Closing loop here for now.
